title: Using this manual
intro: The **User Manual** button is on every screen. Ask a question in your own words, or open the help for the screen you are on. Help only shows the way — it never changes anything.

topics.title: How to use the User Manual
questions: How do I use this help?
What can I ask the user manual?
topics.summary: Click **User Manual** (bottom right of every screen). Type a question such as *Where do I approve hotel rates?* and press **Ask**. The answer gives numbered steps and a button that opens the right screen.

steps.text: Click **User Manual** at the bottom right of the screen.
Type your question in plain words and press **Ask** (or Enter).
Follow the numbered steps. **Bold** words are the exact names of screens and buttons.
Use the blue button in the answer to open the right screen. Opening a screen changes nothing by itself.
Under **Help for this screen** you see the topics for the page you are on.

notes: If the manual has no checked answer, it says so instead of guessing.
So far the manual covers **Hotel Rates**. Other sections are being added.

topics.title: Printable manual (PDF)
questions: Where is the printable user manual?
Can I download the manual as a PDF?
How do I print the user manual?
topics.summary: The printable manual is made from the same instructions as this help, so both always match. Open it from the bottom of the **User Manual** panel: **View PDF** or **Download PDF**.

steps.text: Click **User Manual**, then **View PDF** at the bottom of the panel to read or print it.
Click **Download PDF** to save a copy.

topics.title: I cannot open a screen (no permission)
questions: I do not have access to a screen
Why do I get forbidden or 403?
How do I get permission for a menu?
topics.summary: Each menu entry is a permission given to your user group. Ask your manager; the System Administrator gives it under **Settings → Group Privileges**. Log out and in again afterwards.

steps.text: Note the screen name you need (the manual shows it, for example **Hotel Rate Approval**).
Ask your manager. If it is agreed, the System Administrator adds it under **Settings → Group Privileges**.
Log out and log in again so the new permission takes effect.
